text: {"rules":[{"id":"IPV-SCREEN-WOMEN-REPRO","version":"June 2025","title":"Intimate partner violence screening in women of reproductive age, including pregnant and postpartum women","source_quote":"The USPSTF recommends that clinicians screen for intimate partner violence (IPV) in women of reproductive age, including those who are pregnant and postpartum.","grade":"B","effective_date":"2025-06","action":"Screen for intimate partner violence","denominator":"{\"all\": [{\"sex\": {\"is\": \"F\"}, \"quote\": \"women\"}, {\"uncomputable\": {\"needs\": \"reproductive-age status (the text gives no numeric age range for 'reproductive age')\"}, \"quote\": \"women of reproductive age\"}], \"quote\": \"women of reproductive age, including those who are pregnant and postpartum\"}","numerator":"{\"encounter\": {\"concept\": \"ipv_screening\", \"window\": [\"{MY}-01-01\", \"{MY}-12-31\"]}, \"quote\": \"screen for intimate partner violence (IPV)\", \"derived\": {\"window\": \"the text states no screening interval; a measurement-year window is assumed and needs human confirmation\"}, \"note\": \"ipv_screening is a screening activity; may be recorded as a procedure/assessment rather than an encounter\"}","exclusions":"[]"}],"coverage_notes":["'Reproductive age' is not defined numerically in the section text, so the age bound is encoded as uncomputable rather than approximated with an invented age range. If the clinic adopts a numeric definition, it must be added as a derived criterion and go to human review.","No screening interval is stated; the measurement-year numerator window is a derived assumption flagged for human review.","Pregnant and postpartum women are explicitly included but are a subset of women of reproductive age, so no separate criterion was added.","Referral to or provision of evidence-based multicomponent interventions for those who screen positive (referenced in 'Practice Considerations') is not represented.","Information on IPV in men is referenced in 'Practice Considerations' and is not represented. No rule covers men.","Caregiver abuse of older or vulnerable adults (part of the topic title) is not addressed by a recommendation in this section and is not represented.","The asterisk after the date ('June 2025 *') is unexplained in the section text; its meaning was not captured.","The concept ipv_screening is used from the vocabulary; encoding it as an encounter type may need adjustment depending on how the EHR records IPV screening instruments."]}
